# Vendored frontend libraries

Third-party JS libraries are vendored here, pinned, with their license files and checksums.
Nothing is loaded from a CDN (design NFR-8).

Planned: Cytoscape.js, cytoscape-fcose, cytoscape-expand-collapse, cytoscape-elk + elkjs.
Audit each license before adding it (design §17: cytoscape-svg is reported to be GPL-3.0; elkjs is EPL-2.0).
